name: NetScope | Real-time IP & Network Analyzer
description: Developed by Yousef Honarmand. NetScope provides real-time network insights: view your IP (IPv4 & IPv6), ISP, location, latency, and destination server info including IP, owner, location, latency, and CDN/Cloudflare detection. You can also compare two websites side by side and get real-time notifications if a site goes offline.
author: Yousef Honarmand
